name: Tinkers' Items at the Arcane Anvil

pages.text: $(bold)Tinkers' modifiable items can now take upgrade orbs at Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks' Arcane Anvil$().(br2)How: this mod adds $(bold)tconstruct:modifiable$() (every modifiable Tinkers tool and piece of armor) to Iron's Spellbooks' $(bold)irons_spellbooks:upgrade_whitelist$() tag - so the anvil accepts$(li)left slot: a Tinkers item$(li)right slot: an upgrade orb$(br2)The output is a complete copy of the item plus the orb's attribute bonuses (fire spell power, max mana, melee damage, spell resistance, ...).

$(bold)Limits and removal$(): the number of orbs an item can hold is capped by Iron's Spellbooks' own $(bold)MAX_UPGRADES$() config (3 by default); to undo an upgrade, put a $(bold)Shriving Stone$() in the right slot and the item in the left slot at the same anvil (the orbs are refunded).$(br2)Tinkers' material traits and modifier upgrades $(italic)do not conflict$() with the orb bonuses - both apply at the same time.
